title: Extension to non-text modalities
description: The Transformer is only applied to text input and output. The authors explicitly plan to extend the model to problems involving other modalities such as images, audio, and video.
canonical_description: model only applied to text modality, needs extension to other modalities

evidence.anchor: problems involving input and output modalities other than text
evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
